items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Inequality for Multivariate Polynomials with Sum of Degrees
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        ∑ i, ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For a non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and finite sets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable $ i $, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the Cartesian product $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the sizes $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the sum of the degrees of $ p $ in each variable divided by the corresponding $ |S_i| $. Formally, $$\frac{\#\{x \in S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n \mid p(x) = 0\}}{\prod_{i=1}^n |S_i|} \leq \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{\deg_i(p)}{|S_i|},$$ where $ \deg_i(p) $ denotes the total degree of $ p $ in variable $ i $.

items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that computes a degree bound for multivariate polynomials, taking a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and an element of the sum type $\mathbb{N} \oplus \mathbb{N}$. For left components, it applies $f$ to $n$, and for right components, it returns $n$ directly. This is used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem to establish well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomial constructions.

Formally, $ \frac{\#\{f \in S^n \mid p(f) = 0\}}{\#S^n} \leq \frac{\deg_{\text{total}}(p)}{\#S} $, where $ \deg_{\text{total}}(p) $ denotes the total degree of $ p $.
